channel: #eng-announcements (internal Slack)
message:
:lock: *Action required: rotate your personal API keys and tokens by Friday*

Hi all. As part of the quarterly credential hygiene review, every engineer with a personal API key, token or service password for the payments sandbox needs to rotate it by Friday 17:00 UTC. Nothing has leaked; this is the scheduled rotation.

How to do it:
1. Open Settings > Developer > API keys in the payments dashboard.
2. Find your key. Keys are shown masked, for example sk_live_••••••••••••3f9a, so you can recognise yours by the last four characters.
3. Click "Roll key". The old key keeps working for 24 hours so nothing breaks mid-deploy.
4. Paste the new key into the vault (Vault > Credentials > payments-sandbox), never into a .env file, a ticket, a chat or this thread.
5. If you use a database password for the sandbox replica, rotate it the same way under Vault > Credentials > sandbox-replica.

Do NOT post keys, tokens or passwords in Slack, even partially beyond the last four characters, and even in DMs. If you think a key was exposed, revoke it immediately and ping #security.

Questions in thread. Thanks!
